name: 46077 · Zionsville, IN
findings: ZIP 46077 (Zionsville) has 190 nonprofit organizations. 79 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 66 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46077 (Zionsville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46077 (Zionsville) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
